papers.title: APT: Anchor-aligned Perturbations for Tamper Localization in Fully Regenerated Images
limitations: Inspected sections 3-5 and Appendices A-D; no reproduction.

evidence.claim: Latent perturbations use DINOv3 cosine hinge, worst-10% mining, noisy latent branches and uniform anchors; decoded pixels are clipped.
Table 1: APT PSNR 32.80 dB, AUC .97, IoU .90; APT* IoU .92 versus WAM .84.
limitations: Localization, not payload recovery; PSNR below 35 dB.

evidence.claim: Verifier anchors are server secrets; same-image copy-move may evade localization.
Uniform feature alignment surviving regeneration is prior art; H1 chip-versus-symbol needs a narrower empirical claim.
limitations: Not equivalent to E3 pixel optimization, fixed latent-DCT payload, exact 32-bit Q or public-owner verification.
assumptions: Comparison uses the current E3 description; novelty requires broader search.

open_questions: Can a matched strict-quality, public-owner payload protocol distinguish the mechanisms?
